messages:
irene_ops: Trying to provision 4x A100 in ap-southeast-1 for a customer POC, but the cloud account is stuck in "business verification" and the billing card is flagged. provisioning API returns a 402 + 'merchant_verification_required'. Anyone seen this flow before? :eyes:

alex_chang: ugh, yeah. Did you get the provider error details? sometimes they need a registered business name + tax ID for GPU SKUs. Can you paste the error payload?

irene_ops: here's the snippet from the console: ```{
  "error": "provisioning_failed",
  "code": 402,
  "message": "Merchant verification required. Submit business registration and VAT/tax id to enable accelerated GPUs.",
  "action": "upload_documents"
}```

priya.k: that matches what APAC payments told us last quarter. For ap-southeast-1 they require either local VAT or a company registration doc + signed W-8/W-9 depending on org jurisdiction. Did the customer provide a VAT/BRN?

irene_ops: customer sent a scanned business license but the billing portal shows mismatch (country vs tax id). Payments says we need a "proof of tax residency" to clear the merchant. I've opened a ticket with provider support: ticket ID CLOUD-94281.

billing-bot: Payment status update: Ticket CLOUD-94281 created. Current status: awaiting documentation. Note: GPU quota requests are queued until merchant verification completes. ETA for manual review: 48-72 hours.

marcus: short-term options: 1) spin up smaller non-GPU nodes in the same region and run scaled-down evals to validate infra path (no GPU cost), 2) use our partner account with existing quota (requires cross-account networking setup), or 3) provision in us-west-2 where this customer's account is already verified. Tradeoffs: cross-region latency and egress cost.

irene_ops: thanks. I've started option 1 to unblock dev work. Could someone from platform help test cross-account VPC peering if we go partner route? @marcus? :thumbsup:

marcus: I can take the peering setup. I'll need the partner account ID and a security contact. Also flagging that peering will add NAT/egress dependencies—estimate ~2-3 hours to validate and run a smoke workload.

alex_chang: also FYI deploy-bot just reported failures when the autoscaler tried to allocate GPUs for the canary: ```deploy-bot: [1832501301] scale-up failed: quota_exceeded (gpus:4)``` So good call to fall back.

irene_ops: copied. I'll follow up with the customer to get clarified tax docs and ask them to upload the 'proof of tax residency' the provider requested. Will update ticket CLOUD-94281. Thanks everyone. :pray:

priya.k: FYI, ops playbook note — when merchant verification blocks GPU SKUs in APAC, customers sometimes clear it faster if they attach a notary-stamped company registration + a recent utility bill showing address. Share that suggestion with them.

billing-bot: Ticket CLOUD-94281 updated: owner=irene_ops, priority=high, next_contact=provider_support@cloud.example.com

irene_ops: marking this thread resolved for now — switching to local CPU fallback and partner peering plan in parallel. Will post final status here once provider clears the merchant verification. :white_check_mark:
